steps.content:
May 25, N.F. 116
The 5th day following the attack on the BR-003 Observation Hub
Terminal 0490's data has been updated. You receive a brief yet meaningful document titled Tracing History: Above and Below.

- The Founding of EDGE At its establishment—and in the minds of most who had heard of it—EDGE was a purely scientific organization. The entente was signed for the welfare of humanity, and the institution itself was likewise created in pursuit of a new dawn for the world. Even as EDGE truly emerged from the shadows of history following DisCity's independence, its mission remained the same: to combat Mania and prevent disasters.

But as history took its course, the Mania crisis only worsened. To meet the challenge, EDGE needed greater strength to lead and more alliances to expand its influence.
After decades of evolution, EDGE no longer belongs to a single individual or organization. Representing various cities and factions of humanity, it has become a platform for negotiation, compromise, and cooperation.

This collaborative spirit extends beyond the numbered seats at the top. It drives every source of funding within the EDGE system, every technological breakthrough, and, most crucially, the ordinary humans who make up the foundation of it all.

SHP-13: I'll keep this brief. Regarding 07's opinion and the suggestions all of you have made previously, I have no objections at this time.

SHP-13: BR-003 is our most critical asset. During this transition period, it would be the right course of action to protect it, utilize it effectively, and ensure it continues to serve the cities.

SHP-13: That said, security must become our highest priority.

SHP-13: The attack on BR-003 wasn't merely another breach of our defenses. It exposed failures in our monitoring and warning systems, delays in our security response, and a critical information gap between different levels of command!
[By invoking the Underground as an indisputable common enemy, you ultimately secure EDGE's support for your decision

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: We scanned the attack site and ran a series of analytical models using the collected data. Our findings confirm that the invasion was carried out using dimensional technology comparable to, if not more advanced than, our own.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: While the threat is concerning, the enemy's current technology proved insufficient to breach BR-003 or invade the Ring itself. In other words, the race is not yet over. There's still time.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: I endorse the MBCC Chief's proposal. The Ring Research Institute will provide full support in developing a counter-tracking algorithm based on dimensional superposition calculations. We will trace the intruders back to their source.

SHP-13: One more thing. The Underground stands behind the Sillage Society. They've been infiltrating our factions, scheming against us, and stealing our intelligence... Their operations have not ceased for several years now.
SHP-13: The MBCC has been fighting both the Sillage Society and the Underground all this time. We'd also like to be fully involved in the security vetting of the Ring Research Institute.

SHP-13: Every personnel file, communication record, and access permission related to BR-003 should be reviewed, without exception.
SHP-13: The enemy is clearly not only operating from the outside. The sooner we eliminate the suspects, the sooner we can move on with our operations. This would be in everyone's best interest.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Revealing your action plan openly at an EDGE meeting requires a great deal of trust in everyone present.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: You'll need to trust that no one at that meeting will leak sensitive information, that your actions won't alert the enemy, allowing them to take precautions or even destroy the evidence. Do you trust them that much, Chief?
In truth, you do have a few names in mind, but you're waiting for these treacherous enemies to make a major move. That way, you can catch them all at once.
As for the other suspects... especially the most dangerous one, you've already made arrangements to keep that person under close watch.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Director! I haven't been back in forever. Would you mind giving me a refresher on the engineering projects? I mean, no one else could possibly explain them well enough. It really has to be you!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I'm suuuper, suuuper eager to learn, you know! I could study all day long without taking a single break! That's 24 hours, 1,440 minutes, or 86,400 seconds!

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Of course. It would be my pleasure to guide a genius like yourself, Summer.
Isomer's reputation has soared after successfully rescuing you during the last attack. This means you need to be more discreet—fortunately, Summer's here to help you out.

The scientific prodigy is almost too fired up by the spy mission you assigned her. She's practically had her entire person and her ten thousand drones glued to Isomer at all times. She won't give her a single chance to pull any tricks.

SHP-13: In other words, we're all in agreement to resume the BR-003 research projects.

SHP-13: No problem. The MBCC will handle security. We'll ensure the safe operations of everything without interfering in any academic matters.

SHP-13: If the Underground has set its sights on BR-003, then let them come. We'll cut down every reaching hand and drag out every lurking mole!

PixelBackup12:
Hehe, looks like the Observation Hub fiasco has finally spiraled out of control! Now that a top-secret research facility's involved, those high-and-mighty old fossils are finally panicking. Where was that urgency before?

PixelBackup12:
I peeked at their internal messages. The MBCC's launching a full security audit of the Ring Research Institute. And they're not just checking security protocols. They're digging into cash flows, academic corruption, stuff like that. Others may not know where to look, but don't think you can fool the Gray-Clad Demon!

PixelBackup12:
Time for Pixel's prediction! So, who's getting screwed this time? The project lead? The designer? Or maybe one of our fresh graduates who <color=#fb9259>willingly signed the papers</color>?

PixelBackup12:
But you know what? Doesn't that finally give our poor College of Humanities a chance to shine? Any Journalism and Political Science students here? No? Agh... I'll take even Economics and Business majors. Now's your turn to expose the College of Science! Write some articles to warn us how ugly the truth really is! Oh wait... or are you writer types too scared to ruffle any feathers up top?

PixelBackup12:
Haha, of course not! I know you're all brave champions of justice! Just not feeling those assignments lately, huh? No worries, outsource them to me! If anything goes south, I can even take the blame—for an extra fee, of course!

PixelBackup12:
<color=#fb9259>Our top-tier ghostwriting services cater to all disciplines! Fake data generation, experiment fabrication, you name it! 24/7 support across all academic fields! 100% privately operated and safe!</color>

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: We're about to kick-start a new round of experiments. The technical approaches, objectives, and data sources have all undergone major revisions. The relevant documents and charts have already been distributed to everyone. If there are no further questions, let's get to work.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Moving forward, the Ring Research Institute's Observation Hub will work closely with MBCC, synchronizing combat data. We will track residual Mania spectra left by the Underground's incursions, and crack any dimensional fissure in real time.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: This time, we're not just going to surpass the Underground. We'll pursue them relentlessly and take the fight straight to their doorstep!

The passage is narrow and meandering. The walls on both sides bear enormous, jagged gouges, as though a pack of beasts tore through them with their claws, and then the shattered stones were pieced back together.
The air is thick with a cloying, putrid fog. Amid the piercing growls and frenzied chants, the mist grows ever more lurid and oppressive.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now then...

options: Let's run some errands for the scientists

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Time to gather some field data for her experiments.
